extensionDescription.message: Send selected text, copied text, links, and articles to PaceFlow Reader.

commandDescription.message: Send the selection or current page to PaceFlow

popupTagline.message: Send what you are reading into focus mode.

readyStatus.message: Ready. Nothing is sent until you choose an action.

shortcutHint.message: Shortcut: Alt+Shift+R sends the selection, or the page when nothing is selected.

normalPageRequired.message: Open a normal web page first.

sendFailed.message: PaceFlow could not open this content.

noSelection.message: Select some text on the page first.

clipboardEmpty.message: The clipboard does not contain text.

clipboardFailed.message: Chrome did not allow clipboard access. Paste the text in the box instead.
